messages:
Priya: Quick thread from the postmortem — we need to lock owners for the follow-ups on recurring GPU capacity incidents. Three priority areas: quota requests, scheduler tuning, and headroom cadence. Can owners ack and call out any blockers? @Aisha (SRE) @Marco

Marco: Ack. I'll take quota requests. Will open a tracker and escalate to cloud account team. Expect a ticket + cost estimate by EOW.

Aisha (SRE): I can lead scheduler tuning. Plan: try `preemptionPriority` tweaks + pod disruption budgets and test aggressive bin-packing to reduce fragmentation. I'll draft a k8s patch and run on staging first. Any hard constraints from cost side @Marco?

Marco: Main blocker is quota approval lead time — cloud needs justification + estimated spend. I'll include per-cluster/region numbers in the ticket.

Tom: I'll own headroom planning and alerting. Preference: predictive buffer (trend-based) with a floor of 10% spare GPUs instead of fixed daily buffer. I'll prototype a Prometheus query and share dashboards.

Tom: ```promql
# simple trending example (WIP)
max_over_time(sum by(cluster)(gpu_allocated{job="kube-gpu-metrics"})[2h]) / sum by(cluster)(gpu_capacity)
```

Jacob: Noted recurring spike at ~02:30 UTC driven by nightly batch re-training jobs. Can we gate those or move to low-traffic windows? @Priya can product coordinate?

Priya: Yes — product can shift non-urgent batches. I'll add scheduling options to the ticket and contact teams running the jobs.

DeployBot: Created issue INF-4219: "Quota requests for additional GPU capacity" (assignee: Marco)

Marco: :thumbsup: I'll update INF-4219 with regional breakdown, expected ramp, and cost delta. ETA Fri COB for request submission.

Aisha (SRE): Scheduler plan: prepare k8s config patch, run a 24h canary in staging + one low-traffic prod cluster, run perf/latency checks, then roll cluster-wide. Target canary next Tue.

Tom: Will publish the headroom dashboard and set an alert when predicted utilization > 85% by end of day. Also will add a weekly report for the cadence meeting.

Priya: Summary of action items:
- Marco: INF-4219 quota ticket + cost estimate — ETA Fri COB
- Aisha (SRE): scheduler k8s patch + canary — target Tue
- Tom: headroom dashboard, predictive query, alerting — ETA EOD today
- Priya: coordinate batch scheduling changes and stakeholder comms — ongoing

Let's follow up in the capacity cadence meeting on Wed 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: when you understand/accept ownership. If anything slips, please update the ticket directly. Thanks team.
